{{Top|leg}}
'''Athari''' was a term used for the [[Fathalian]] inhabitants of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Athar]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[JanFathal]]. They had dark skin, and most of them wore their hair in neatly-coiled plaits. They spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] with an accent.
